HELLOSPIRE-OLD_IRON.title: Old Iron
HELLOSPIRE-OLD_IRON.description: At the start of each combat, [gold]Load[/gold] 3 [gold]Lead Rounds[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-OLD_IRON.flavor: Older than the road it walks. It has never once misfired, and never once been clean.
HELLOSPIRE-TRUE_IRON.title: True Iron
HELLOSPIRE-TRUE_IRON.description:
At the start of each combat, fill all 6 chambers with [gold]Lead Rounds[/gold].
[gold]Lead Rounds[/gold] deal 1 additional damage.
HELLOSPIRE-TRUE_IRON.flavor: Whatever it was made from, it was not iron.
HELLOSPIRE-OILED_RAG.title: Oiled Rag
HELLOSPIRE-OILED_RAG.description: The first time each combat you [gold]Load[/gold], also [gold]Load[/gold] 1 [gold]Lead Round[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-OILED_RAG.flavor: Black with use, and worth more than the coat it lives in.
HELLOSPIRE-TIN_BADGE.title: Tin Badge
HELLOSPIRE-TIN_BADGE.description: The first time each turn you apply [gold]Weak[/gold], gain 3 [gold]Block[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-TIN_BADGE.flavor: Nobody ever asked to see the paperwork.
HELLOSPIRE-SPARE_SPEEDLOADER.title: Spare Speedloader
HELLOSPIRE-SPARE_SPEEDLOADER.description: The first time each combat the [gold]Cylinder[/gold] becomes completely empty, [gold]Load[/gold] 3 [gold]Lead Rounds[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-SPARE_SPEEDLOADER.flavor: For the moment you learn how you count.
HELLOSPIRE-LONGCOAT_PLATES.title: Longcoat Plates
HELLOSPIRE-LONGCOAT_PLATES.flavor: Sewn in one winter, and never taken out again.
HELLOSPIRE-LUCKY_COIN.title: Lucky Coin
HELLOSPIRE-LUCKY_COIN.description: The first time each turn you [gold]Spin[/gold]: if the current chamber is loaded, draw 1 card; if empty, gain 4 [gold]Block[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-LUCKY_COIN.flavor: It has come up the right way every time so far. That is what worries them.
HELLOSPIRE-ENGRAVED_HAMMER.title: Engraved Hammer
HELLOSPIRE-ENGRAVED_HAMMER.description: The first Round you successfully [gold]Fire[/gold] each turn deals 4 additional damage.
HELLOSPIRE-ENGRAVED_HAMMER.flavor: Six names down the side. Room for more.
HELLOSPIRE-IVORY_HANDLE.title: Ivory Handle
HELLOSPIRE-IVORY_HANDLE.description: Rounds other than [gold]Lead Rounds[/gold] deal 3 additional damage.
HELLOSPIRE-IVORY_HANDLE.flavor: Expensive, impractical, and it sits in the hand like it was grown there.
HELLOSPIRE-HOLY_SYMBOL.title: Holy Symbol
HELLOSPIRE-HOLY_SYMBOL.description: Your first [gold]Faith[/gold] gain each combat is multiplied by [blue]{Bonus}[/blue].
HELLOSPIRE-HOLY_SYMBOL.flavor: Worn smooth by a thumb that has never once let go of it.
